title: Rwendo rweMweya Wakatorwa
intro: Munguva iyo tsika dzenzanga dzaive dzakasimba, munhu akasiyana akaona shanduko huru mumhuri yakakomborerwa. Nyaya yavo, yakaratidzwa nechisungo cherudo uye chirevo chaMwari, inoratidza kuputswa kwetsika dzekare uye kugadzwa kwenheyo itsva, dzakarurama. Nyaya iyi inoratidza kukosha kwechokwadi kupfuura tsika nepfungwa dzeuchenjeri dziri shure kwemirairo yaAllah.
clues: Ndakambova musungwa, asi kuburikidza nehurongwa hwaMwari, ndakawana musha mutsva nemhuri itsva.
Ndaidiwa zvikuru zvekuti pandakapiwa sarudzo pakati pemhuri yangu chaiyo neyandakarerwa nayo, ndakasarudza kuramba ndiri pamwe chete nemwana uyu.
Zita rangu raimboshandiswa pakundichengeta, tsika yaiwanzoitika munharaunda yangu.
Ndini ndoga shamwari yeMuporofita wekupedzisira ane zita rakataurwa pachena naAllah muQuran.
Ndakaroora mukadzi ane chiremera uyo aiva hama yemuprofita, asi muchato wedu hauna kugara kwenguva refu.
Mushure mekurambana kwangu, Allah pachake akarayira kuti aimbova mudzimai wangu aizoroorwa neMuporofita, nokudaro achibvisa tsika yekare pamusoro pekutorwa kwemwana.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
